title: "undefined reference to" with your own library in ROS 2: target_link_libraries, ament_export_targets, extern "C", templates and the stale-binary "symbol lookup error", measured
excerpt: Why colcon fails with undefined reference to your own library: a missing link, a file left out of add_library, extern "C", templates and include-only exports. Plus mylib::mylib target not found and symbol lookup error after a library-only rebuild. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
